chung: Original character illustration for a xianxia cultivation game. Art style: Chinese ink-wash (shuimo) painting blended with refined semi-realistic digital illustration; delicate confident brush linework, soft watercolor washes, muted desaturated palette of ink black, warm grey and rice-paper white with ONE restrained accent color; beautiful refined face with detailed realistic eyes, flowing layered hanfu robes whose hems dissolve into ink-bleed brush strokes. Full body, standing, the whole figure visible from head to feet with empty margin around it, three-quarter view facing slightly left, calm graceful pose, hands relaxed. Plain pure white background, no scenery, no ground shadow, no text, no logo, no watermark, no frame.
